mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.stated_objective_pain_point: Objectively evaluate CSRM/DSL metamodel quality using QM4MM metrics and verifiable requirements, because eliciting quality requirements across many CubeSat stakeholders is arduous; use results to guide specification robustness and iteration.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.system_boundary_level_of_abstraction: CSRM data-model/profile and associated OWL ontology at DSL/metamodel abstraction. It addresses classes, inheritance, object properties, documentation, equivalent-class mappings, and quality constraints—not a mission-specific spacecraft, subsystem, EPS, behavior execution, or physical architecture implementation.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.minimal_or_excluded_modeling: The research focuses on the SPO data model; the process model is explicitly excluded from quality analysis. EPS elements, mission behavior, hardware/software integration, physical tests, and flight operations are not modeled/evaluated. Knowledge correctness is not empirically tested.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.required_prior_behavioral_domain_knowled: Existing CSRM/domain ontology and domain-SME knowledge are assumed. Metric selection requires deep understanding of modeling goals and ontology logical foundations; authors assume SMEs constructed CSRM with due diligence.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.handling_limited_behavioral_knowledge: The method avoids behavioral/process analysis by evaluating structural data-model properties with SPO semantics, counts, equations, and ontology mapping. It does not demonstrate a method for eliciting or validating unknown CubeSat/EPS behavior.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.generality_reuse_notes: CSRM is presented as a reusable CubeSat DSL/profile and a mission-agnostic baseline for mission-specific purposes. The metamodel-quality workflow is method guidance. These are stated design mechanisms/intended uses, not evidence of repeated project reuse, an evaluated open package, or physical-system validation.
mbse_objective_scope_artifacts.generality_reuse_mechanism_v1_1_reasonin: The current paper explicitly names a reusable space-mission ontology, a CSRM profile, and a DSL-quality method. It does not demonstrate reuse across projects. Appendix A is expressly excerpted prior work, so its repository/license diagram and broad capability statements do not support additional current-paper reuse codes.

governance_roi_project_decision_linkage.evaluation_criteria_model_quality_useful: QM4MM-derived cohesiveness (LCOM), coupling (CBO), conciseness (RD), specificity (SD), clarity (SCR), learnability (ULe), documentation/class/relationship counts, hypothesized thresholds, and OWL semantic consistency. governance_roi_project_decision_linkage.model_derived_performance_indicators_man: CSRM metamodel-quality indicators are reported (counts and LCOM/CBO/RD/SD/SCR/ULe). They are technical metamodel diagnostics, not project management, cost, schedule, reliability, power, or mission-performance metrics.

key_findings_by_rq.RQ1: Partial relevance only. CSRM is a mission-agnostic CubeSat reference model/profile based on a reusable space-mission ontology, and the study evaluates a high-level SPO data model rather than behavior. It does not model EPS or explain how to represent unknown behavior; it explicitly omits the process model.
key_findings_by_rq.RQ2: No direct RQ2 evidence. The paper evaluates metamodel/ontology quality, with a metric-calculation test, one CSRM metric assessment, a semantic-consistency statement, and a narrow OWL-to-CCM mapping proof of concept. These are not EPS modeling outcomes and do not establish EPS reliability, reproducibility, or integrability.
key_findings_by_rq.RQ3: Partial relevance only. Quality requirements are linked to value properties and evaluated with executable SysML parametrics; OWL consistency is checked with a semantic reasoner. These are integrated pre-physical metamodel/ontology checks, not EPS verification procedures, mission behavior verification, hardware/software integration, testbed, environmental test, or flight validation.

author_stated_limitations_gaps: The quality framework is not comprehensive because many metrics exist.
The process model was not considered in the quality analysis.
Metamodel knowledge correctness was not empirically assessed because the authors assume domain SMEs constructed CSRM with due diligence.
Metric parameters are estimates needing refinement as more DSL case studies are completed.
SCR/clarity evaluation is a proof of concept and needs a mature DSO for true quality implications.
The paper describes the method as in its infancy and calls for comparison with other-domain modeling languages.
extractor_identified_limitations_gaps: No EPS elements, EPS requirements, power analyses, or EPS-specific V&V evidence are present.
No mission-specific lifecycle stage, hardware/software integration, flat-sat/testbed, environmental test, operational validation, or flight evidence is reported.
Manual-versus-parametric arithmetic is confined to a synthetic eight-class test environment; there is no baseline for actual CSRM quality or asserted organizational/project benefits.
Only OWL-to-CCM import/mapping is demonstrated; no broader toolchain continuity, round-trip, or mapping-fidelity evidence is described.

The displayed CSRM RD and SD values/thresholds create ambiguity relative to the broad narrative conclusion; CBO is described qualitatively but no final numeric CBO row is visible in the supplied Markdown table.
Metric counts include UML/SysML elements, affecting interpretation of CSRM-only quality values.
Appendix A is prior-work lineage and is not counted as new current-paper evidence of reuse, traceability, V&V, availability, or lifecycle continuity.

synthesis_consistency.notes_for_consistency_with_lineage: This is a CSRM DSL/metamodel-quality paper, not a new CubeSat mission implementation or an EPS/physical verification case. Appendix A explicitly reproduces prior work [71]; its architecture, reuse, traceability, and V&V statements are retained only as lineage context. The current paper's original evidence is the QM4MM/parametric/semantic analysis, including the synthetic test environment and CSRM data-model counts.
synthesis_consistency.extraction_confidence_reason: Method, equations, artifact roles, test-environment calculations, CSRM counts, semantic-check statements, and author limitations are explicit.
